name: io.github.olzhas-raiganiyev/goszakup-mcp
title: Kazakhstan Public Procurement (goszakup)
description: Read-only access to Kazakhstan public procurement data: announcements, lots, contracts, plans, unreliable suppliers.

environmentVariables.name: GOSZAKUP_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Data source: 'mock' (offline sample data, default) or 'ows' (official API, needs a token)

environmentVariables.name: GOSZAKUP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token for the goszakup.gov.kz open-data API, issued by the Ministry of Finance of Kazakhstan
